_metadata.description: Requirement stubs scaffolded from the P1 operational targets.

requirements.description: Every account created as a persona is recorded with its site, login seam, and recovery path, which is the prerequisite for retiring a persona without orphaning what it created
requirements.title: Credential linkage register

validation.notes: Accounts service tests cover credential linkage with site, login seam, recovery path, and named handoff address [REQ:PSN-P1-001].

requirements.description: Billing and shipping addresses held per persona and releasable into a named handoff or resolution, under the same entitlement rule as documents
requirements.title: Address book per persona

validation.notes: Accounts service tests cover per-persona address bindings and entitlement boundaries [REQ:PSN-P1-002].

requirements.description: What each persona has signed up for, its renewal date, and its cancel path; the identity half of a recurring commitment whose money half belongs to treasury
requirements.title: Obligation registry

validation.notes: Accounts service tests cover renewal and cancellation obligations without money movement [REQ:PSN-P1-003].

requirements.description: When notification-hub is available a handoff reaches the operator on the right device; when it is absent the built-in queue still works, so the relay is an enhancement and never a dependency
requirements.title: Handoff delivery through notification-hub

validation.notes: Handoffs service tests cover built-in queue behavior independent of optional relay delivery [REQ:PSN-P1-004].

requirements.description: A persona surfaces what is expiring or broken — a document past its validity date, a mailbox that no longer authenticates, an unreachable OTP route — before a flow discovers it mid-enrolment
requirements.title: Persona health and staleness

validation.notes: Persona, channels, and documents service tests cover expired bindings, unavailable authorities, and unreachable OTP routes [REQ:PSN-P1-005].

requirements.description: Which team members may act as which persona is ordinary member configuration in prompt-manager, keeping organisational policy where teams already live rather than duplicating a roster here
requirements.title: Act-as grants held in prompt-manager

validation.notes: Access service tests cover act-as grants and proposal-only ACL decisions consumed by the external grant seam [REQ:PSN-P1-006].

requirements.description: Emit a token carrying the full delegation chain for a counterparty to verify, aligned to the DIF KYA-OS direction rather than inventing a private claim shape
requirements.title: Signed identity attestation

validation.notes: Access service tests cover signed identity attestation generation and refusal for missing signer authority [REQ:PSN-P1-007].

requirements.description: An enrolment assembles every field a target requires, reports exactly which remain human-only, and presents them as one handoff instead of many
requirements.title: Enrolment preparation as a first-class flow

validation.notes: Handoffs service tests cover checkpoint composition and resumable enrolment preparation [REQ:PSN-P1-008].
